note: About 148 acres near Vienna on a 25-acre private lake, bordering the Shawnee National Forest with hiking and riding trails from camp. A former trail-riding ranch that still hosts horse and mule events, with a riding arena and a few stalls; also cabins, a clubhouse and fishing. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, about, events), Campspot park record, site types, prices and park map, and Google panel read: family campground on a private lake, 103 RV sites on Campspot (20/30/50 A, water), $30 every date read (Nov 2026, Jan 2027, Jun 2027), bookable in January, stays over 21 days need approval; showers, flush toilets, dump. Google 4.4/53. Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway. Groups written manual; note cleaned. HORSE: former trail-riding ranch marketed to 'nature-lovers and horse riders', no separate horse area described: weak drop candidate for AWH.
flags: HORSE (DROP CANDIDATE, weak; AWH judgement): the operator home page: 'Our family campground offers the perfect getaway for nature-lovers and horse riders of all ages and levels', 'direct access to unlimited hiking /riding trails', 'With stunning views and riding trails'; about page: 'Formerly known as Cedar Lake Ranch ... to trail ride'; a 'Horse Shows' photo album; events page '3rd Annual Fall Heartland Mule from November 7th to 15th, 2026'. The Campspot park map marks three horse stalls beside the showers/restrooms/dump cluster, and imagery shows a riding arena in the north-west field near the RV loops. Nothing describes a horse area separate from the RV sites. Against it: the Campspot listing is a general family campground ('clubhouse, the great fishing on site, the playground, special events'), with no horse site types and no mention of horses; the stored note already said 'Popular with horse riders but not limited to them'. Unlike Bay Creek Ranch (1747) it does not call itself a horse campground. Under the MDC rule ('not EXPLICITLY separated') this could be a drop; my read is a general campground that welcomes riders.

LONG-STAY: no seasonal or monthly wording anywhere; Campspot policy 'Stays over 21 days must be approved by management'. All 103 RV sites are sold nightly online (nightly share ~100% of the online inventory). Pass.
PRICE: $30 a night every date read (Nov 2026 to Jun 2027), under the $50 gate. Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km. PRESENCE: operator site with phone + Campspot booking; Google 4.4/53.
SITE COUNT: stored note said 'more than 200 sites'; Campspot sells 103 RV sites (the park map SVG has ~112 site shapes). Written 103 with a note that tent sites and cabins are separate.
SEASON: written year_round: Campspot sells every RV type for nights in November 2026 and late January 2027.

WATERFRONT: stored not waterfront, not --AWH: no change. The RV road on the lake's west side runs between the sites and the tree-lined shore; the south row is ~150 m from the water. At best a view across the park road; defaults down.
PIN: stored 37.49957,-88.79913 is at the office by the entrance, ~185 m NNE of the rough site centroid (~37.4980,-88.7998); Campspot point 37.499545,-88.799191 agrees with the stored pin. Ok.

PHONE: keep 618-695-2600 (operator 'Office'); the operator's cell 618-838-2251 is the Campspot phone. WEBSITE: keep https://www.cedarlakecampground-shawnee.com/ and https://www.campspot.com/book/cedar-lake-campground.
SEWER: no Campspot type lists sewer; left unknown.
OHV: the Campspot waiver lists ATV, side-by-side and dirt-bike use among activities; no OHV area or trail described. Flag only.
